title: BGS (Breast Cancer Now Generations Study) — Derived Variables table (CD3 schemify pilot)
description: Array of R0 derived-variable records. One element is one participant's analysis-ready derived variables at baseline. Full pilot: all 60 properties from DerivedVariables_Schema.json converted, across 12 categories.
$comment: Standard JSON Schema cannot enforce uniqueness of TCode across rows, nor cross-field arithmetic identities (e.g. R0_BMI = R0_Weight / (R0_Height/100)^2). See the README's 'Documented but not enforced' section.
